rule: Accumulation into a computed key of a plain object is a defect wherever the key domain is open, because `__proto__` is silently dropped and `constructor` concatenates onto the Object function. A site may stay on a plain object only with a recorded measurement showing its key domain is closed. Every entry below names the guard that closes it, so the claim can be re-checked when that guard moves.

sites.measurement: projectId is parsed from persisted client state (GektaChatWorkspace.tsx:129 accepts any string), so a viewer who edits their own browser storage to projectId="__proto__" makes that project's chat counter read 0. The blast radius is the editing viewer's own sidebar count in their own browser: no server state, no other viewer, no authorization decision. Presentation code is excluded from this programme's change scope by the repository owner, so the site is recorded rather than rewritten.

A decision reaches summariseDecisions only through byId, and byId.set runs only after validateDecision passed, which requires VALID_APPLICABILITY.has(decision.applicability) - a Set, so it has no inherited members. A decision failing that check is pushed to `rejected` and skipped with `continue`, and buildSummary makes rejected.length > 0 a blocker that clears finalPass. Requirements with no decision take the literal APPLICABILITY.PENDING.
sites.closedBy: VALID_APPLICABILITY Set membership check in validateDecision
